player.seasonOutlook: Flagg is coming off a Rookie of the Year campaign but has the potential for major improvements in Year 2. Last season, then-head coach Jason Kidd experimented with Flagg at point guard, an added level of difficulty for a rookie already making the transition to the highest level. This season, new coach Dusty May and returning point guard Kyrie Irving should put Flagg in more advantageous positions to attack defenses. His stats should increase across the board, giving him fantasy upside as high as top-10.

Sabonis' season was cut short by a knee injury that limited him to only 19 games, by far the fewest in a campaign in his career. In his three previous full seasons with the Kings, Sabonis had averaged a rounded 19 points, 13 rebounds and 7 assists in 77 games per year. The Kings have signaled a rebuild, letting veterans like DeMar DeRozan walk, and there are rumors that Sabonis could be on the move as well, but as long as he remains in Sacramento expect Sabonis to bounce back to his typical usage levels this season.
